<!-- ============================================================
     STACKED IT — BRANDED HOMEPAGE (demo-style, brand palette, PHOTO-READY)
     Paste into a "CMS content" Front page section near the top.
     CSS-only, scoped under .sit-home.

     Category photos are embedded (transparent PNGs from Computers.zip).
         Phones currently uses an external iPhone image link — swap it for
         your own store's image when you can.
     ============================================================ -->
<style>
/* Gotham Rounded (subset, embedded) */
@font-face{font-family:'Gotham Rounded';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Gotham Rounded';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Gotham Rounded';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}

  .sit-home{--orange:#EE7623;--orange-dk:#d4621a;--yellow:#F4AF23;--ink:#25282A;--ink-2:#1b1e20;
    --slate:#3a4147;--peach:#fff3ea;--mist:#f4f6f8;--line:#e7ebee;--muted:#616365;
    font-family:'Gotham Rounded','Montserrat','Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--mist);margin-top:-40px}
  .sit-home *{box-sizing:border-box}
  .sit-home .wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
  .sit-home a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
  .sit-home section{margin:0}
  .sit-home .band{width:100vw;position:relative;left:50%;right:50%;margin-left:-50vw;margin-right:-50vw}
  .sit-home .sec{padding:46px 0}
  .sit-home .sec-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .sit-home .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,30px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0}
  .sit-home .sec-head a.more{color:var(--orange);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .sit-home .sec-head a.more svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.4}

  /* ===== VALUE STRIP ===== */
  .sit-home .value{background:#EE7623;color:#fff}
  .sit-home .value-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .sit-home .value-col{padding:22px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px}
  .sit-home .value-col:last-child{border-right:none}
  .sit-home .value-col svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:2;flex:none}
  .sit-home .value-col b{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;display:block}
  .sit-home .value-col span{font-size:12.5px;color:#fff0e6}
  @media(max-width:760px){.sit-home .value-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.sit-home .value-col:nth-child(2){border-right:none}}

  /* ===== BIG CATEGORY TILES ===== */
  .sit-home .tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:16px}
  .sit-home .tile{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;min-height:210px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
  .sit-home .tile:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(31,38,43,.18)}
  /* photo area (falls back to icon) */
  .sit-home .tphoto{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:96px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .sit-home .tphoto img{max-width:100%;max-height:118px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
  .sit-home .tphoto .ph{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
  .sit-home .tphoto .ph svg{width:28px;height:28px;fill:none;stroke-width:1.9}
  .sit-home .tphoto.noimg img{display:none}
  .sit-home .tphoto.noimg .ph{display:flex}
  .sit-home .tile h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin:0;line-height:1.15}
  .sit-home .tile .sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;opacity:.85;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:3px}
  .sit-home .tile .sub svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke-width:2.6}
  .sit-home .t-dark{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3033,var(--ink));color:#fff}.sit-home .t-dark .ph svg{stroke:var(--yellow)}
  .sit-home .t-orange{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff}.sit-home .t-orange .ph svg{stroke:#fff}
  .sit-home .t-yellow{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8c04a,var(--yellow));color:var(--ink)}.sit-home .t-yellow .ph{background:rgba(0,0,0,.08)}.sit-home .t-yellow .ph svg{stroke:var(--ink)}
  .sit-home .t-slate{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#454d54,var(--slate));color:#fff}.sit-home .t-slate .ph svg{stroke:var(--yellow)}
  .sit-home .t-peach{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff6ef,#ffe6d3);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}.sit-home .t-peach .ph{background:rgba(238,118,35,.12)}.sit-home .t-peach .ph svg{stroke:var(--orange)}
  .sit-home .t-mint{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#eef7f5,#dcefe9);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}.sit-home .t-mint .ph{background:rgba(45,122,116,.12)}.sit-home .t-mint .ph svg{stroke:#2d7a74}
  @media(max-width:1000px){.sit-home .tiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
  @media(max-width:560px){.sit-home .tiles{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

  /* ===== TRENDING (CIRCLES) ===== */
  .sit-home .trend{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:30px 26px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(31,38,43,.06)}
  .sit-home .circles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:14px}
  .sit-home .circ{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center;transition:transform .18s ease}
  .sit-home .circ:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
  .sit-home .circ .ring{width:92px;height:92px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, #fff, #f1f4f7);border:1px solid var(--line)}
  .sit-home .circ:hover .ring{border-color:rgba(238,118,35,.5);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(238,118,35,.16)}
  .sit-home .circ .ring img{width:78%;height:78%;object-fit:contain}
  .sit-home .circ .ring .ph{display:none}
  .sit-home .circ .ring .ph svg{width:40px;height:40px;stroke:var(--orange);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7}
  .sit-home .circ .ring.noimg img{display:none}
  .sit-home .circ .ring.noimg .ph{display:block}
  .sit-home .circ span{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#333}
  @media(max-width:900px){.sit-home .circles{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
  @media(max-width:520px){.sit-home .circles{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}

  /* ===== DEAL BANNERS ===== */
  .sit-home .deals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
  .sit-home .deal{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;padding:30px 32px;min-height:160px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
  .sit-home .deal h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .sit-home .deal p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;opacity:.9;max-width:340px}
  .sit-home .deal .db{margin-top:10px;align-self:start;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:9px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .sit-home .deal .db svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:2.4}
  .sit-home .deal.mint{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#e7f5f1,#d3ece4)}
  .sit-home .deal.peach{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff1e6,#ffe0c9)}
  .sit-home .deal .ghostnum{position:absolute;right:-10px;bottom:-26px;font-size:120px;font-weight:800;opacity:.08;line-height:1}
  @media(max-width:720px){.sit-home .deals{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

  /* ===== LENOVO FEATURE ===== */
  .sit-home .feature{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:20px;color:#fff;
    background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 88% 12%, rgba(238,118,35,.28), transparent 60%),linear-gradient(150deg,#2c3033,#25282A 55%,var(--ink-2));
    padding:42px 46px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .sit-home .feature::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-70px;left:-70px;width:230px;height:230px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, var(--yellow), var(--orange) 60%, var(--orange-dk));opacity:.85;filter:blur(2px)}
  .sit-home .feature .fc{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:640px}
  .sit-home .feature .eyebrow{display:inline-block;background:rgba(244,175,35,.16);color:var(--yellow);
    border:1px solid rgba(244,175,35,.45);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:30px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
  .sit-home .feature h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,36px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 10px;color:#fff}
  .sit-home .feature h2 .hl{color:var(--yellow)}
  .sit-home .feature p{font-size:16px;color:#c7d0d6;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:540px}
  .sit-home .feature .offer{position:relative;z-index:1;flex:none;text-align:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 28px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(0,0,0,.18))}
  .sit-home .feature .offer .up{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#e7edf1}
  .sit-home .feature .offer .num{font-size:60px;font-weight:800;line-height:.9;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--yellow),var(--orange));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
  .sit-home .feature .offer .num sup{font-size:22px;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--orange)}
  .sit-home .feature .offer .off{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}

  .sit-home .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:10px;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
  .sit-home .btn-pri{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(238,118,35,.32)}
  .sit-home .btn-pri:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(238,118,35,.42)}
  .sit-home .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.4}

  /* ===== PROMO CAROUSEL ===== */
  .sit-home .carousel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(31,38,43,.14)}
  .sit-home .track{display:flex;width:200%;animation:sitSlide 14s infinite}
  .sit-home .carousel:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}
  .sit-home .slide{flex:0 0 50%;display:block}
  .sit-home .slide img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
  @keyframes sitSlide{0%,44%{transform:translateX(0)}50%,94%{transform:translateX(-50%)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
  .sit-home .dots{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:9px;z-index:2}
  .sit-home .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
  .sit-home .dot.d1{animation:sitDot1 14s infinite}
  .sit-home .dot.d2{animation:sitDot2 14s infinite}
  @keyframes sitDot1{0%,44%{background:#fff}50%,100%{background:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}}
  @keyframes sitDot2{0%,49%{background:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}55%,94%{background:#fff}100%{background:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.sit-home .track{animation:none}.sit-home .dot{animation:none}}

  /* ===== SEO HELPERS ===== */
  .sit-home .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
  .sit-home .seo-intro{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
  .sit-home .seo-intro h2{font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,30px);font-weight:800;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-align:center !important}
  .sit-home .seo-intro p{font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 auto 12px;line-height:1.65;text-align:center !important}

  /* ===== QUOTE CTA ===== */
  .sit-home .quote{text-align:center;padding:54px 0 60px}
  .sit-home .quote h2,.sit-home .quote p{text-align:center !important;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
  .sit-home .quote h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,32px);font-weight:800;margin:0 0 10px}
  .sit-home .quote p{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 22px}
  .sit-home .quote .btns{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .sit-home .quote .btn-dark{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
  .sit-home .quote .btn-dark:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
</style>

  </section>

  <!-- BIG CATEGORY TILES -->

        <a class="circ" href="https://shopit.stacked.ie/product_list?query=Keyboard+and+Mouse+KM7321W"><span class="ring"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Keyboards" onerror="this.parentNode.classList.add('noimg')"><span class="ph"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M6 10h.01M10 10h.01M14 10h.01M18 10h.01M8 14h8"/></svg></span></span><span>Mice &amp; Keyboards</span></a>
